blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Preparations for the Philippines’ hosting of the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits are already 95 percent complete, with organizers setting aside the remaining 5 percent for possible natural calamities, an official said. Asean Director-General for Operations Hellen Dela Vega said the government had conducted multiple simulation exercises to prepare for different scenarios ahead of the Nov. 15 to 17 summit. “I told some members of the media who have been asking me, as well as our agencies here, that my assessment is that we are 95 percent complete [on our preparations],” Dela […]...
